input_rule: all 20 rows accepted by the frozen p=7 weak-order short-Weierstrass gate
curve_family: a1=47*k1, a2=47*k2, a3=47*k3 for each k in {-1,0,1}; solve a4,a6 exactly from both centered lifted point equations; scan lexicographic (k1,k2,k3)
reduction: require all coefficients integral at 47, 7 and 11, good reduction at all three primes, and equality to the fixed source curve y^2=x^3-x-2 at 47
relation: check P1+2*P2 in E(Q), E(F_47), E(F_7), E(F_11) whenever defined; retain every candidate status
selection: first lexicographic candidate satisfying both p=7 and p=11 gates per input pair, separately for strict and weak p=11 arms
resource: complete 540-candidate exact screen, no wall-time performance comparison
interpretation: finite coefficient-choice family on the prior accepted 20-pair panel; not an unrestricted CRT search
